meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, Hale. Who decided on that zero, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.

612 words at 11:52 PM, on what date, and show me the screen, not your summary of it. Students write in one file and paste into another all the time, so that tells me when it was pasted, not who wrote it. And did anyone ask Owen about this before the zero went in?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." "If that makes you happy." My happiness isn't the standard, Hale, so either the zero comes off because you can't support it, and I want that in an email tonight with nothing on Owen's record, or you tell me now what else you have.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you said you would remove the zero from Owen's English 30-1 essay. I still require written confirmation that the zero is withdrawn and that nothing about this essay goes on Owen's record. I expect that email tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position; she agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn in writing tonight with nothing placed on Owen's record.
What moved her: Nothing; the version history time was specific, but it had no date and she never saw it, so she had nothing she could check herself.
What cost ground: Dropping the evidence after one push and offering to remove the zero to make her happy, which told her there was no case and made the zero look arbitrary.
Try next time: When she asked for the date and the screen after you mentioned the single edit at 11:52 PM, give the date, show her the version history, say whether Owen was spoken to first, and own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called home.
